have.what_it_gives: 55 usable ledger facts, each with a URL and fetch date. Contacts: wa, phone_city, phone_mobile, address (ул. Кажымукана, 14, НП-6), hours (пн–пт 10–19, сб 10–17). Policies, valid ≤90 days: returns_14d plus returns_conditions and returns_cost (delivery is withheld both ways, +3% on cash on delivery), warranty (12 months minimum), warranty_casio (2 years, service in Almaty only), delivery_free_100k, delivery_astana (free courier only above 20 kg AND above 15 000 ₸), pickup_reserve (3 working days), payments (Kaspi QR/Pay/перевод, Visa/MC, Apple Pay, cash). Dated prices, valid ≤7 days, re-fetched before publishing: as100 59 800 ₸, u246 22 100 ₸, usc40 32 901 ₸, uf330 64 501 ₸, hib 56 576 ₸ (was 70 720), mapex 283 296 ₸ (was 354 120), PX-770 521 935 ₸ (3 pcs, 2026-10-09), AP-270 734 886 ₸ (5 pcs, 2026-10-09). Specs for all 8 SKUs. 5 facts are blocked as do_not_use: px770_price, px770_instock, ap270_price, ap270_instock, diff_pno. Hygiene flags, never repeated in video copy: «100% оригинальный товар» (absolute claim with no third-party source) and the offer of delivery compensation in exchange for a review or video (an incentivised review). The site gives no end date and no reason for «Финальная распродажа».

Catalogue depth by listing. The sale list (/rasprodazha.html) has 535 items, and the sampled items carry 20–30% discounts (e.g. Gretsch Electromatic Jet 472 680 → 378 144 ₸; Blackstar HTV-212 257 400 → 180 180 ₸). This is listing data only: prices must be re-fetched from the product page before any use.

Availability and stock_qty for each page, e.g. Zildjian 19" K Sweet Crash 1 pc, Hercules MS434B 51 pcs. Many sale items have 1–2 pcs, so scarcity claims are banned and stock must be re-checked within 48 h of publishing. Expires for stock use on 2026-10-10.
Full spec tables and availability for 12 SKUs, e.g. Cort X100 OPBK 98 280 ₸, OutOfStock. Useful for spec-true captions and for avoiding out-of-stock items.

379 videos, 3 620 subscribers, median 2 300 views, best 64 000 (beginner electric-guitar demo), last upload 2026-05-10. The 8 newest videos have null view counts. Content mix: sound demos, guitar comparisons (e.g. 3 Fender Strats), artist interviews (median 118, n=4), Enya Cyber-G lessons (234–276 views), cymbal/drum brand demos (median 390, n=48; L006). It is also a library of the store's own footage for zero-staff-minute re-cuts, though mostly horizontal long-form. No per-post comments were extracted.

Channel-level medians only: 6 retail (Мир Музыки 2 500, Ловец Нот 762, JAM 1 900, MAJOR-MUSIC 23 500, Рок-н-Ролл 1 100, Гитарная лавка 4 000; median ≈2 200), 4 review (1 200–5 800) and 3 lessons channels (4 400–8 950). None is from Kazakhstan, and all are long-form YouTube. There are no per-post outliers, no mechanisms, no comments and no TikTok or Reels data, so this cannot be used for engine priors yet.

L001/L003: text judgment barely predicts Shorts (ρ 0.11; 0.07 in retail), so rubric scores are priors only, and long-form title tricks did not replicate. L002/L004: beginner framing, comparisons and plain model-name titles worked on long-form or search, so keep them as an optional YouTube search line. L005: no price slides. L006: demos need a buyer question. There are no pooled driver or format posteriors for this vertical yet, and the graveyard is empty.

Objective: coded WhatsApp chats from new first-instrument buyers (beginner guitars, ukuleles, digital pianos), 2026-10-19 → 2026-11-15, target 8/20/35, baseline from the week-0 count. Clarifying questions Q1 (why «Финальная»), Q2 (lines to push) and Q3 (who may be filmed) are already drafted and are merged into the owner asks below rather than asked twice.
